facts.claim: Self-test checks only the HTTP status of each manifest.selftest path
facts.value: create_app(NETWORK False, TESTING True); client.get(path); status >= 400 fails; any exception fails (BaseException). No JavaScript run, no sub-resources fetched. Unlisted pages are never opened: broken unlisted route PASSES

facts.claim: Current selftest list has 9 paths; /globe would be the 10th
facts.value: /healthz, /, /history, /history?event=demo, /candidates, /outlook, /places, /sources, /app. Default when key missing: /healthz, /

facts.claim: The self-test bypasses the Gate; a real start needs /healthz 200
facts.value: selftest calls create_app and test_client directly; Gate wraps only in serve() (launcher.py:433-434). activate() starts the poller (NETWORK on, TESTING False) before its /healthz 200 check (350-352)

facts.claim: The app sends no CSP, X-Frame-Options, CORS, Referrer-Policy or nosniff header
facts.value: Probe: none present. Grep of payload/ and desktop/ for CSP, frame, CORS, after_request, headers: only the cookie and HTTP-client uses

facts.claim: Host check and session cookie (D2)
facts.value: Host must be 127.0.0.1:<port> or localhost:<port> (else 400). Cookie hw_session must equal the one-time key (else 403). /__auth sets HttpOnly; SameSite=Strict; Path=/

facts.claim: Would the app block a /globe page loading cdnjs, NASA GIBS or NOAA?
facts.value: No. Nothing restricts outbound loads; the Gate sees only 127.0.0.1 requests. Cross-origin WebGL texture upload needs the provider's CORS headers (browser rule; W1/W2 report *)
